zh: 到火车站的时候，火车已经开走了。
old_en: By the time we got to the station, the last train had already left.
new_en: By the time we got to the station, the train had already left.

zh: 到家才发现，钥匙忘在公司了。
old_en: I didn't realize until I got home that I had left the keys at the office.
new_en: I didn't realize until I got home that I had left the keys at the office.

zh: 我到家门口才发现钥匙落在办公室了。
old_en: Only when I reached the door did I realize I had left the keys in the office.
new_en: I didn't realize until I got to the door that I had left the keys at the office.

zh: 吃完饭我才想起没带钱包，只好回了一趟家。
old_en: After finishing dinner, I remembered I had forgotten to take my wallet, so I went back home.
new_en: After finishing dinner, I remembered I had left my wallet at home, so I went back.

zh: 结账时才发现，钱包忘在家里了。
old_en: When it was time to pay, I realized I had left my wallet at home.
new_en: When it was time to pay, I realized I had left my wallet at home.

zh: 到机场的时候，航班已经被取消了。
old_en: By the time we arrived at the airport, the flight had already been canceled.
new_en: By the time we got to the airport, the flight had already been canceled.

zh: 睡觉之前，我已经把作业做完了。
old_en: I had already finished my homework before I went to bed last night.
new_en: I had finished my homework before I went to bed.

zh: 昨晚睡前，弟弟已经把作业写完了。
old_en: My brother had finished his homework before he went to bed last night.
new_en: My brother had finished his homework before he went to bed.

zh: 到医院的时候，医生已经下班了。
old_en: By the time we got to the hospital, the doctor had already gone home.
new_en: By the time we got to the hospital, the doctor had already gone home.

zh: 我们赶到医院时，门诊已经关门了。
old_en: By the time we arrived at the hospital, the outpatient clinic had already closed.
new_en: By the time we got to the hospital, the outpatient clinic had already closed.

zh: 出门以后我才发现窗户没关，又回去了一趟。
old_en: I had forgotten to close the window after I left, so I went back to do it.
new_en: I realized the window was open after I left and went back.

zh: 我们赶到车站时，末班车已经开走了。
old_en: By the time we arrived at the station, the last train had already left.
new_en: By the time we got to the station, the last train had already left.

zh: 我们赶到机场时，那班飞机已经取消了。
old_en: We had already arrived at the airport when that flight had been canceled.
new_en: When we arrived at the airport, that flight had already been canceled.

zh: 我到公司的时候，会议已经开始了。
old_en: I had already arrived at the company when the meeting had already started.
new_en: When I got to the company, the meeting had already started.

zh: 赶到会议室时，大家已经开始讨论了。
old_en: By the time I arrived at the conference room, everyone had already begun discussing.
new_en: By the time I got to the conference room, everyone had already started discussing.

zh: 走到楼下才发现窗户没关，我又上楼了。
old_en: I had gone downstairs before I realized the window was open and had to go back up.
new_en: I went downstairs and realized the window was open, so I went back up.

zh: 开会之前，他已经把材料准备好了。
old_en: He had finished preparing the documents before the meeting started.
new_en: He had prepared the documents before the meeting started.

zh: 会议开始前，他就已经把资料准备好了。
old_en: By the time the meeting began, he had already prepared the documents.
new_en: By the time the meeting began, he had already prepared the documents.

zh: 到餐厅的时候，朋友已经点好菜了。
old_en: By the time we arrived at the restaurant, our friends had already ordered their dishes.
new_en: When we got to the restaurant, our friends had already ordered their dishes.

zh: 我赶到餐厅时，他们已经点完菜了。
old_en: When I got to the restaurant, they had already finished ordering their dishes.
new_en: When I got to the restaurant, they had already ordered their dishes.
